div.p: An optional attribute of formAvailable that specifies the type of form or instantiation being described.

Use formAvailableType with formAvailable to specify the type of form or instantiation being described. Use e.g. "analogOriginal" for an analog original instantiation such as a charter, map, drawing, paper file, etc.
Use the attribute formAvailableTypeEncoding in control to identify the list of authoritative terms that can be used as values of formAvailableType.
